arStrings.szText: At the end of {c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} the demon explodes, dealing {c_number}{payload:BLAST_IMPACT}{/c} damage. The explosion damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|x%|]{/c} for each time the demon's breath hit enemies.

{c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} {c_important}Recast{/c} Skill and summons a larger demon for {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} seconds that {c_important}{u}Executes{/u}{/c} {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies. Recast to aim and blast enemies {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} times for {c_number}{payload:ABYSS_BLAST}{/c} damage.
Enemies permanently take {c_number}[{SF_34}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage from {c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} each time it hits them, up to {c_number}[{SF_34}*{SF_35}*100|x%|]{/c}.

Casting {c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} infuses your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills to grant {c_number}{SF_37}{/c} seconds of {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} per hit for {c_number}{SF_36}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_39}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage but costs {c_number}[{SF_38}*100|%|]{/c} more Dominance.
{c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_42}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage the first time it hits an enemy but no longer pierces.

{c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} becomes a {c_important}Channeled{/c} fire breath attack that transforms you into {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_number}{payload:FIRE_BREATH_DF_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage per hit. {c_important}Infernal Breath's{/c} cost is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|%|]{/c} while you have {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c}.
